name: an open protocol
headline: An open *protocol*
say: Hypercomb is not an app you sign up for. It is an open protocol: a shared way to name, keep and pass on what people make, that anyone can use and no one owns. Three ideas carry it. Every piece of work is named by a fingerprint of its own content. Every change is kept. And work travels between people directly, from device to device and domain to domain. The code is public, under a licence that keeps every copy open.
